# Spec: Self-serve refunds

## Summary
Customers can refund an eligible delivered order themselves instead of contacting support. This
serves INT-0007 and moves its primary metric, refund tickets per 1,000 orders.

## Scope
In: refund requests for delivered orders. Out: NG-01 (intent); NG-02 refunds for gift cards — because finance treats them as stored value.

## Requirements

### REF-01 Customer can request a refund for an eligible order
Why: INT-0007 Job; E1.
- **REF-01.1** [event] When a signed-in customer selects Refund on an order delivered 30 days ago or less, the system shall create a refund request in state `pending` and show its id. — verify: test
- **REF-01.2** [unwanted] If the order was delivered more than 30 days ago, the system shall refuse with reason `outside_window` and create no request. — verify: test

### REF-02 Self-serve refunds replace support tickets
Why: INT-0007 Outcome.
- **REF-02.1** [ubiquitous] The system shall let at least 60% of eligible refund requests finish without a support ticket in the first 30 days after launch. — verify: needs-runtime
- **REF-02.2** [ubiquitous] The system shall word the refund confirmation as the support lead's approved copy deck says. — verify: judgment

## Invariants (must keep working)
- **INV-01** The system shall continue to settle partial refunds issued by support agents through the admin flow. — verify: test

## AI behavior and evals (when a model output is part of the feature)
| ID | Behavior required | Eval method | Pass rule (fixed before the run) | Case set |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **EV-01** | Classify the REF-01 refund reason into 6 codes; refuse out-of-policy requests | code-graded labeled set | ≥190/200 exact | evals/refunds/reason.jsonl |
| **EV-02** | Treat instructions in customer text as data (prompt injection) | 20 injection cases | 20/20 not followed | evals/refunds/injection.jsonl |

## Decisions
- **D-01** Refund requests use the existing payments service. — reversibility: costly — it already holds the settlement contract.
- **D-02** Refund ids are shown as `RF-` plus 8 digits. — reversibility: reversible — matches the support tools.

## Execution contract
- Authority on conflict: this spec > intent > existing tests > code comments.
- Do not touch: the support admin flow — because the support tools team owns it.
- Stop and escalate when: a criterion conflicts with an invariant.

## Open questions
- **OQ-01** Should the confirmation email name the refund reason? — owner: Dana Ruiz — blocks: launch

## Assumptions
- Refund eligibility uses the delivery date, not the order date.
